CustomField.description: Minutes during which Start Campaign refuses to start the same Salesforce Campaign or Account again with the same Fonada agent, so a retry or a repeated "yes" does not call everyone twice. Blank = 10. 0 = off.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Minutes during which the same Salesforce Campaign or Account cannot be started again with the same Fonada agent (prevents double calls). Blank = 10, 0 = off.
CustomField.label: Repeat launch guard (minutes)
